title: Antisabbatarian

inlines.v: ANTISABBATA'RIAN, noun [anti and sabbath.] One of a sect who oppose the observance of the Christian sabbath; maintaining that the Jewish sabbath was only of ceremonial, not of moral obligation, and was consequently abolished by Christ.
